items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: He worked for my daddy. And my daddy, we used to call him Joe. Little Black Joe.

ctx.x: Did your father ever give any music lessons or teach any other drummers or anybody that you ever saw around the house? Yeah, he did.

I can tell you one boy I remember that was a fine little drummer that my daddy taught. He worked for my daddy. And my daddy, we used to call him Joe. Little Black Joe. He was a little dog fella in the car. He worked for my father for years in the shop.
You don't remember his last name? No, I don't remember his name. I know they used to call him Joe.
